text:
emma: quick doc-sync: finalizing changelog for the 0.11 feature rollout. Need to call out the known issues and the small migration gotchas. Post single-line items here.

noah: core items: adaptive routing beta (opt-in), SDK streaming rename -> `generate_stream()`, cache TTL default changed to 1800s, routing fallback cost-preference update.

harper: PR 4257 updates the Python examples to `generate_stream()` and calls out chunk_size >= 1024 recommended. I also fixed a bad internal link in examples/embeddings-quickstart.md. CI still shows one warning: missing alt text in images in guides/perf-tuning.md.

docs-ci: build green for PRs 4257, 4263. Lint: 1 warning (images alt text).

emma: draft changelog bullets: - Adaptive routing (beta, opt-in) + sample flag; - Streaming API rename and workaround for v0.9.x; - Cache TTL default change; - Ded->Priv migration note re: kvs_cache; - Minor sample and link fixes.

noah: add "For engineers" section with small diffs: show `kvs_cache` YAML snippet and routing flag snippet.

harper: I'll add migration snippet to migration-guides/dedicated-to-private.md in PR 4263.

release-bot: scheduled docs deploy 2026-03-22T22:00Z pending green checks :rocket:

emma: timeline: merge 4257/4263 by 19:00Z, freeze for copy until 20:00Z, then publish. I'll post the final changelog link here when live.

noah: also note: examples/quantization.md should not reference `q4_0` directly. Replace with `--model-family gpt-small-quant`. PR 4268 opened.

emma: great. Adding a short Known issue: "Streaming SDK v0.9.x: may drop final chunk with small client chunk sizes; workaround: increase `chunk_size` >= 1024 or upgrade to v0.10.x." Kept wording minimal.

harper: thanks. I'll take alt text warnings separately. This thread resolved for changelog content. :white_check_mark:
